Arcade Level 11-20 / Ver. 1.02 Update !
'Zombie Shooting Star: Arcade Level' ROUND 2 ... FIGHT!

Angry Rudy does not subside even if he destroys everything he sees in front of him.
Cooperative operation with police zombies!
'Dead or Alive, You're coming with me!' Kill the bad zombies with the police zombies.
If the mission fails, will you be able to see Rudy's bewildered face?
Enjoy the feeling of a 'Runner' who can freely roam around the city center
Enjoy the thrill of surviving the onslaught of mutants!

but...

Can't enjoy zombie slaughter at arcade levels 11-20?

Do not worry! A space arcade where you can enjoy traditional zombie slaughter awaits you!
Defeat all mutants and become a legendary pop star with the victorious 'MOON WALK'.

notes.title: Zombie Shooting Star : Arcade level 01-10 / Ver. 1.01 Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=XgqXa8e2Gr8;full][/previewyoutube]
'Gun play / Slash' Enjoy true zombie slaughter in arcade levels!
The jump queen training course, puzzles, vehicles, tanks, hover tanks, motorcycles, and bicycles that gave you pain
All have been disposed of.

And the cowardly and disrespectful ones (Chainsaw, Kappa, Hugger, Glutton) were not invited.
A cute little guy named Mortal won't bite unless you get close.
He says he likes to throw a ball in his mouth. How about playing ball together?

Bosses with lowered HP will challenge Rudy!
Defeat the challenger and don't forget to tea-bagging with the newly added 'Emot 5 Twerking'!

Moving floors, boss relay challenges, and tank battles await you!

If you are a Rudy who has just started the game, you can use the weapon obtained in advance in the arcade level.
You can go scolding the main level mutants.

According to the news, small construction drones on the planet Yunia are urgently dispatched!
It is said that the main level terrain safety reinforcement and anti-mutant energy equipment installation missions were successful.

The chainsaw is weakened by the influence of the equipment, the number of Level 02 Mutant Wings decreases, etc.
It did a lot of damage to the schemes of the Mutant Core.
 
The small drones were attacked by gargowings and mutant wings while returning to the portal after successfully completing their mission.
It's all destroyed. My condolences...
The survival rate has increased at the extreme main level. Crush them more daringly!

Needless to say, it's time to start the real zombie slaughter in the arcade level.

Zombie Shooting Star  Ver. 1.01 Update

 Added Arcade Levels 01 - 10
 Added emote 5 twerking
 Main level difficulty adjustment
 Added new achievements
 Some convenience improvements
 bug fix
